# Universal repository .gitignore
#
# This is a conservative baseline for polyglot repositories and monorepos.
# It ignores high-confidence generated or machine-local files while avoiding
# broad directory names that may contain source code in another ecosystem.
#
# Add project-specific outputs to the closest nested .gitignore. In particular,
# do not add these names globally without confirming their ownership:
# bin/, build/, dist/, lib/, out/, pkg/, public/, reports/, target/, vendor/
#
# Lockfiles are intentionally tracked for reproducible builds.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operating systems
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# macOS
.DS_Store
.AppleDouble
.LSOverride
._*
.DocumentRevisions-V100/
.fseventsd/
.Spotlight-V100/
.TemporaryItems/
.Trashes/
.VolumeIcon.icns
.com.apple.timemachine.donotpresent

# Windows
Thumbs.db
Thumbs.db:encryptable
ehthumbs.db
ehthumbs_vista.db
Desktop.ini
$RECYCLE.BIN/

# Linux desktop and network filesystems
.directory
.Trash-*/
.fuse_hidden*
.nfs*

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Editors and local workspace state
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Visual Studio Code project configuration is intentionally tracked.
.vscode/*.log
.vscode/.ropeproject/

# JetBrains IDEs: ignore user-local state, not the entire .idea directory.
.idea/**/workspace.xml
.idea/**/tasks.xml
.idea/**/usage.statistics.xml
.idea/**/shelf/
.idea/**/httpRequests/
.idea/**/dataSources.local.xml
.idea/**/dynamic.xml
.idea/**/uiDesigner.xml
.idea/**/dbnavigator.xml

# Visual Studio
.vs/
*.suo
*.user
*.userosscache
*.sln.docstates

# Vim
*.swp
*.swo
*.swn

# Emacs
*~
\#*\#
.\#*

# Local editor history
.history/
.local-history/

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Temporary files, caches, logs, and runtime state
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.cache/
.tmp/
.temp/
tmp/
temp/

*.bak
*.old
*.orig
*.tmp

*.log
*.log.*
*.pid
*.pid.lock
*.seed
*.stackdump

npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
yarn-error.log*
pnpm-debug.log*
lerna-debug.log*

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Local configuration and secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.env
.env.*
!.env.example
!.env.example.*
!.env.sample
!.env.sample.*
!.env.template
!.env.template.*
!.env.defaults

.direnv/

# Never use broad patterns such as *.key, *.pem, or *.crt here. Repositories
# may intentionally contain public certificates, test fixtures, or examples.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# JavaScript, TypeScript, and web tooling
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

node_modules/
.npm/
.pnpm-store/

# Yarn Zero-Install artifacts such as .yarn/cache and .pnp.cjs are intentionally
# not ignored because some repositories commit them.
.yarn/unplugged/
.yarn/build-state.yml
.yarn/install-state.gz

.eslintcache
.stylelintcache
*.tsbuildinfo

.parcel-cache/
.turbo/
.nx/cache/
.nx/workspace-data/

.next/
.nuxt/
.output/
.svelte-kit/
.astro/
.vite/
.vitepress/cache/

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Python
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

__pycache__/
*.py[cod]
*$py.class

.pytest_cache/
.mypy_cache/
.ruff_cache/
.pyre/
.pytype/
.hypothesis/
.tox/
.nox/

.coverage
.coverage.*
htmlcov/

.eggs/
*.egg-info/
pip-wheel-metadata/

.venv/
venv/

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dart and Flutter
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.dart_tool/
.packages
.pub/
.pub-cache/
.flutter-plugins
.flutter-plugins-dependencies

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# JVM, Gradle, and Maven
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.gradle/
.mvn/timing.properties

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# .NET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

*.userprefs
*.rsuser
*.sln.iml

# bin/ and obj/ are intentionally project-local because both names can hold
# source or checked-in tooling in a polyglot repository.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C, C++, and CMake
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CMakeCache.txt
CMakeFiles/
cmake_install.cmake
CTestTestfile.cmake
compile_commands.json
Testing/

# Compiled extensions are intentionally not ignored globally because binary
# fixtures and distributable native libraries may be committed deliberately.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rust
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Cargo.lock is intentionally tracked. Add target/ to each Rust project's
# nearest .gitignore so an unrelated source directory is never hidden.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Go
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

coverage.out

# vendor/ is intentionally project-local because vendored dependencies may be
# committed and other ecosystems may use the name for first-party source.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terraform and infrastructure tooling
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.terraform/
*.tfstate
*.tfstate.*
.terraform.tfstate.lock.info
crash.log
crash.*.log
*.tfplan
.terraformrc
terraform.rc

.serverless/
.aws-sam/
cdk.out/
.vercel/
.netlify/

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

*.retry

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TeX and LaTeX
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

*.aux
*.bbl
*.bcf
*.blg
*.fdb_latexmk
*.fls
*.lof
*.lot
*.out.ps
*.run.xml
*.synctex.gz
*.toc
*.xdv

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test and coverage tool state
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.nyc_output/

# Generic reports/, screenshots/, snapshots/, and coverage/ directories are
# intentionally not ignored. They may contain reviewed or published artifacts.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mantle test artifacts
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Output files created by bin/ commands when run without isolation during development.
system-report.md
system-report.txt
system-report.json
apt-freeze/

# These are backup files generated by rustfmt
**/*.rs.bk

# MSVC Windows builds of rustc generate these, which store debugging information

# Generated by cargo mutants
# Contains mutation testing data

# RustRover
#  JetBrains specific template is maintained in a separate JetBrains.gitignore that can
#  be found at https://github.com/github/gitignore/blob/main/Global/JetBrains.gitignore
#  and can be added to the global gitignore or merged into this file.  For a more nuclear
#  option (not recommended) you can uncomment the following to ignore the entire idea folder.
#.idea/
